vertStrideDesc: 3 float16 per vertex = clip-space X, Y, W (row-major by grid index). Z is omitted: Z = W * zwRatio (clip Z and W are identical to 1e-4).
headerLayout: magic[4]=WSQ2, u32 frameCount, u32 gridN=128, u32 vertStride=3, u32 format(1=f16), f32 zwRatio
zReconstruction: Z = W * zwRatio (then gl_Position = (X, Y, W*zwRatio, W)); NDC = (X/W, Y/W).
vertOrder: row-major by grid index (same as wave_geo.bin / wave_seq.bin); positions only
normalsUVsource: static from wave_geo.bin (cols 4:7 normal, 7:9 uv); lighting unchanged across frames
playback: Forward loop. Advance keyframes at sourceFps/keyframeStride = 12.00 keyframes/sec (i.e. real-time 60fps source). LERP linearly between consecutive keyframes.
crossfadeNote: The SPU cloth is noise-driven and never exactly recurs: the minimum NDC RMS loop residual is ~0.12-0.18 for ANY segment length in the 12s capture, so a crossfade is required. Crossfade the last 5 keyframes back into keyframe 0 (LERP fade) to hide the residual shape snap.
realtimeSpeedNote: perFrameMeanMotionNDC is the measured NDC displacement per 1/60s source frame. Play at sourceFps=60 (one source frame per 1/60s) so the cloth moves at the firmware's true speed.
f16QuantNote: X,Y,W quantized to float16; quantization error is well below per-frame motion.
